svg.text: Eight prefixes from the same random orbit, plus a coarse occupancy read so the growth is not just decorative.
The useful question is timing: when does the fern become legible, and when does the upper canopy start owning area?
the main silhouette is already there
most coarse cells are already claimed
Blue: occupied cells anywhere in the fern box. Mint: occupied cells in the upper canopy band.
